events.name: Kaş International Film Festival (Kaş Film Fest)
events.when: annually in June; 5th edition scheduled for June 2026, with the award ceremony at the ancient Antiphellos Theatre in Kaş
events.blurb: Annual film festival supported by Türkiye's Ministry of Culture and Tourism and Kaş Municipality, featuring screenings, finalist Q&A sessions and an award ceremony at the 2,000-year-old Antiphellos ancient theatre. Held in Kaş town, roughly 30 km from Patara Beach.

events.name: International Lycia Kaş Culture and Art Festival
events.when: annually in late June (typically around 25-27 June); organised by Kaş Municipality
events.blurb: Three-day cultural and arts festival organised by Kaş Municipality with concerts, performances and cultural events celebrating the Lycian region. Held in Kaş town, the nearest district centre to Patara Beach.

events.name: Kaş Jazz Festival (Kaş Caz Festivali)
events.when: annually in late August (around the last weekend; recent editions on 23-25 August) at Setur Kaş Marina
events.blurb: Annual open-air jazz festival held at the Setur Marina in Kaş, featuring Turkish and international jazz acts. Kaş is the nearest town district to Patara Beach.

events.name: International Meis-to-Kaş Swimming and Canoe Contest
events.when: annual cross-border open-water swim and canoe race from the Greek island of Meis (Kastellorizo) to Kaş harbour, about 7.5 km
events.blurb: Annual open-water swimming and canoeing contest crossing roughly 7.5 km from the Greek island of Kastellorizo (Meis) to Kaş harbour, symbolising Greek-Turkish friendship. Based in Kaş town.

events.name: Antalya Golden Orange Film Festival (Altın Portakal)
events.when: annually in early October; 59th edition 1-8 October 2026
events.blurb: Turkey's oldest and most prestigious film festival, held annually in Antalya with screenings, an awards gala and open-air events in the city centre near Konyaaltı.

events.name: Antalya Akra Jazz Festival
events.when: annually in late May to June; 9th edition 5-20 June 2026
events.blurb: An annual jazz festival bringing world-renowned and local jazz musicians to Antalya for open-air concerts over several weeks in the early summer.

events.name: Antalya Culture Road Festival (Antalya Kültür Yolu Festivali)
events.when: annually as part of Turkey's nationwide Culture Road Festival (2026 series runs April-November); Antalya leg includes free concerts and events on Konyaaltı Beach
events.blurb: Part of Turkey's nationwide Culture Road Festival, the Antalya edition stages free concerts, art and gastronomy events, with Konyaaltı Beach (Konyaaltı Sahili) used as one of the main open-air venues.

events.name: Konyaaltı Beach Park Summer Concerts
events.when: annually throughout the summer season (roughly June-September), open-air concerts along the Konyaaltı seafront and Beach Park
events.blurb: Throughout the summer the Konyaaltı seafront and Beach Park host a regular series of open-air concerts by Turkish pop and other performers, right beside the beach.

events.name: Commemoration of Atatürk (10 November)
events.blurb: Nationwide and locally observed commemoration of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, marked across Antalya with a moment of silence and ceremonies on the anniversary of his death.

events.name: International Lycia-Kaş Culture and Art Festival
events.when: annually towards the end of June (held since 1997); typically around 25-27 June
events.blurb: Long-running festival organised by the Kaş Municipality together with the Greek island of Kastellorizo (Meis), featuring folk dance, music, a swimming race and cross-border friendship events. Held in Kaş town, the nearest locality to Kaputaş Beach.

events.name: Kaş International Film Festival
events.when: annually in June; 5th edition scheduled for June 2026
events.blurb: International film festival supported by Türkiye's Ministry of Culture and Tourism and the Municipality of Kaş, with its award ceremony held at the 2,000-year-old Antiphellos Ancient Theatre. Awarded the EFFE Label 2026-2027 by the European Festivals Association.

events.name: Kaş Jazz Festival (Kaş Caz Festivali)
events.when: annually in late August, at Kaş Setur Marina; 2025 edition ran 28-31 August
events.blurb: Jazz festival held at Kaş Setur Marina featuring prominent Turkish and international jazz musicians, with morning wellness sessions and evening concerts. In its 7th year as of 2025.
